name: udaimania
description: Ask about your day. Udaimania's timeline of what you worked on, read locally from your Mac.

interface.shortDescription: Your day's timeline, from the Udaimania Mac app.
interface.longDescription: Udaimania records what you work on and turns it into a timeline. This plugin lets you ask where your time went and draft standups and weekly reviews from it. Everything is read from the Udaimania app on this Mac; nothing is uploaded by the plugin.
defaultPrompt: @Udaimania what did I work on today?
@Udaimania where did my time go this week?
